commands_run: cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p athena-data 2>&1; cargo test -p athena-core --test model_roster 2>&1

cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p athena-core --test model_roster 2>&1; cargo test -p xtask --test policy 2>&1; cargo test -p xtask --test spec 2>&1; cargo test -p xtask --test ci_shards 2>&1; cargo test -p athena-core --test external_calls_guard 2>&1

policy_denials.detail: grep -n "REPO_CONFIG\|mod tests\|fn verifier_that_can_produce" crates/athena-data/src/config.rs | head -30; sed -n 1315,1345p crates/athena-data/src/config.rs; sed -n 20,40p athena.toml; sed -n 2015,2030p docs/spec.toml; sed -n 1,25p CHANGELOG.md; grep -n "external_calls_guard\|refusal_corpus" xtask/shard-timings.txt; cat crates/athena-data/tests/repo_config.rs | head -30
cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p athena-data 2>&1 | tail -25; cargo test -p athena-core --test model_roster 2>&1 | tail -15

cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p athena-core --test model_roster 2>&1 | grep -v Compiling; cargo test -p xtask --test policy 2>&1 | grep -E "test result|FAILED|failed|panicked"; cargo test -p xtask --test spec 2>&1 | grep -E "test result|FAILED|panicked"; cargo test -p xtask --test ci_shards 2>&1 | grep -E "test result|FAILED|panicked"; cargo test -p athena-core --test external_calls_guard 2>&1 | grep -E "test result|FAILED|panicked"
cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings 2>&1 | tail -n 5; cargo test --locked 2>&1 | grep -E "^test result|FAILED|failed|panicked|error" | sort | uniq -c
cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings 2>&1; cargo fmt --all --check 2>&1; echo fmt=$?
